about.title: shamelessly delicious
paragraphs:
tigre tigre is for when there's no one to impress.
And when you're the hardest person to impress.

Our oil is greasy. For real.
The garlic is dangerous.
And crunchy.

Our oil is greasy. For real.
The garlic is dangerous.
And crunchy.
The heat is worthy of ramen soup.

We have no qualms about what you put us on.
We only care if you think about us after.

Our mission is simple: to be missed.
To be the nagging thought
that you want to satisfy.

What you're holding is part of the first 1000 jars of tigre tigre.
We released them without design, without a pretty label, and without pretensions.

But this is our most important label.
The one with the QR code.
It leads you to a feedback form, because even before we think about visuals, we want to be sure of the most important thing – the taste.

These 1000 jars are limited.
After them, there will be a real label, large production, and fewer apologies.

But this here is the beginning.
The version where taste matters more than packaging and your opinion is part of the product.

howTo.title: How to eat it?
paragraphs:
There's no right way.
There's your way.

Put a spoonful on eggs, pasta, noodles, or rice.
Works with meat, vegetables, and anything that needs a little heat and you want to give it a lot of character.

You can mix it in.
You can pour it on top.
You can eat it straight with bread, if you can't be bothered.

tigre tigre isn't measured in grams and recipes.
It's eaten by eye, by stomach, and without shame.
